current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法——DSGNN 模型。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm based on graph summaries——DSGNN model.
technical_features: 采用“领导——工作者”工作模式
利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
在工作节点上对子图进行小批量样本的学习
使用图摘要技术生成规模远小于原图的子图
通过注意力层将训练结果返回给领导节点
根据梯度同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: Partitioning the original graph using a graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation
Performing mini-batch training on subgraphs at worker nodes
Generating subgraphs much smaller than the original graph using graph summarization technology
Returning the training results to the leader node through an attention layer
Synchronously updating the models on all computing nodes according to the gradient
